definitions.explanation: An amount of money equal in value to something else, such as a refund equal to what was paid or cash equal to goods or points. A business and legal word: {相当|そうとう} (equivalent to) + {額|がく} (amount).

examples.japanese: {相当額|そうとうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返金|へんきん}します→返金する：21322_henkinsuru⟧。
examples.english: We will refund the equivalent amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相当額|そうとうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: To claim an amount equal to the damage.

examples.japanese: ⟦ポイント→ポイント：11283_pointo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相当額|そうとうがく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Points can be used as the cash equivalent when you shop.

notes:
USAGE:
Often follows a description of what the amount matches: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月分|げつぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相当額|そうとうがく} (the equivalent of three months' pay), {一万円|いちまんえん}{相当額|そうとうがく}. In everyday speech, ~⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧ says the same thing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相当額|そうとうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay the equivalent amount
- {相当額|そうとうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返金|へんきん}する→返金する：21322_henkinsuru⟧: to refund the equivalent amount
- {相当額|そうとうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{引|ひ}く→差し引く：06701_sashihiku⟧: to deduct the corresponding sum
